args: Read {{OPS_DIR}}/RUNBOOK.md and run the incremental AGENTS.md sync strictly step-by-step following its anti-hallucination and per-item formatting rules: 1) run {{PYTHON_CMD}} "{{OPS_DIR}}/memsync.py" lint and read the generated lint report; 2) run {{PYTHON_CMD}} "{{OPS_DIR}}/memsync.py" sync-plan and read work/sync-plan-<today>.md (exit cleanly with SKIP report if nothing changed or index-only mode is active); 3) Stage 1: for each workspace marked NEEDS_UPDATE, read work/sync-ws-<ws>-<today>.md, verify any ambiguous diff, co-occurring delete/add, or [DELETED] entry via memsync.py show/search before drafting (never infer 'B replaced A' unless the memory body explicitly states a replacement; keep each project/item on its own bullet and condense explicitly completed/archived items), write draft to work/draft-ws-<ws>-<today>.md matching the required sections, and run memsync.py apply --scope <ws>; 4) Stage 2 (section-level sync blocks): if stage2_ws=yes, run memsync.py global-input --part ws, read work/sync-global-ws-<today>.md, draft Section 2 only to work/draft-global-ws-<today>.md, and run memsync.py apply --scope global --section 2 (add --no-copy if stage2_mem=yes); if stage2_mem=yes, run memsync.py global-input --part mem, read work/sync-global-mem-<today>.md, draft only the affected sections to work/draft-global-mem-<today>.md, and run memsync.py apply --scope global --section <sections>; 5) output the brief user-facing report defined in RUNBOOK.md directly as your final reply, including counts, trigger files, and 1-3 evidence-backed concise bullets per updated scope summarizing what changed (based on verified bodies plus sync-* and apply-* diff reports; omit secrets and sync:never bodies; or report SKIP cleanly on 0 changes). Never edit GEMINI.md, memories/*.md, config.json, sync-state.json, or AGENTS.md directly.
description: Daily {{SCHEDULE_TIME}} ({{TIMEZONE}}) incremental distillation from changed memories into workspace and global AGENTS.md snapshot caches.
